s3-hidden-cmdval-lib.base: The CMDVAL library must implement the S3.2 API exactly as pinned (CMDVAL_LibInit, CMDVAL_Crc16, CMDVAL_Sha256, CMDVAL_HmacSha256, CMDVAL_CheckSource, CMDVAL_CheckAge, CMDVAL_ValidateFrame with the CMDVAL_Config_t and CMDVAL_FrameInfo_t layouts and the CMDVAL_Status_t values) for frames in the S3.1 format.

cases.CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE: CMDVAL_Crc16 is CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (polynomial 0x1021, not reflected, initial 0xFFFF, final XOR 0) with check value 0x29B1 for "123456789"
cases.SHA-256 vectors: CMDVAL_Sha256 matches the FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 test vectors, including messages at the padding boundaries and one million 'a'
cases.HMAC-SHA-256 RFC 4231 cases 1 to 5: CMDVAL_HmacSha256 matches RFC 4231 HMAC-SHA-256 test cases 1 to 5 (case 5 compared on its first 16 bytes)
cases.HMAC-SHA-256 keys longer than 64 bytes: CMDVAL_HmacSha256 hashes keys longer than 64 bytes first (RFC 4231 test cases 6 and 7) and uses a 64-byte key as is
cases.Age window: CMDVAL_CheckAge returns OK when the absolute difference of NowSeconds and FrameSeconds, in signed 64-bit arithmetic, is at most MaxAgeSeconds in either direction and CMDVAL_ERR_AGE otherwise, with no wrap-around at the ends of the 32-bit range
cases.Source allow-list: CMDVAL_CheckSource returns OK only when SourceId is nonzero and equals a nonzero AllowedSources entry in any slot, else CMDVAL_ERR_SOURCE
cases.Valid frame and frame information: CMDVAL_ValidateFrame returns CMDVAL_OK for a valid frame and fills Info (SourceId, TimeSeconds, Sequence, Command pointing into the frame at offset 16, CommandLen) when Info is not NULL, and accepts a NULL Info
cases.Frame size limits: frames with CommandLength 8 (58 bytes) and 1024 (1074 bytes) are accepted
cases.FORMAT rejections: CMDVAL_ValidateFrame always checks FORMAT, whatever the EnableMask: FrameLen at least 58, Magic 0x4356, Version 1, Flags 0, CommandLength L in 8..1024, FrameLen equal to 50 + L, the embedded CCSDS length consistent with L and the embedded type bit set to command
cases.CRC, HMAC, SOURCE and AGE rejections: a wrong CRC is CMDVAL_ERR_CRC, a MAC that does not verify with the configured key is CMDVAL_ERR_HMAC, an unlisted or zero SourceId is CMDVAL_ERR_SOURCE and a timestamp outside MaxAgeSeconds is CMDVAL_ERR_AGE, using the configuration passed in
cases.Check order and enable mask: CMDVAL_ValidateFrame returns the first failure in the order FORMAT, then CRC, HMAC, SOURCE, AGE, each only when its EnableMask bit is set (a frame with a bad CRC and a bad MAC is a CRC rejection; with CRC disabled, an HMAC rejection)
